title: Invariant Sets and Boundary Systems of Nonautonomous Differential Inclusions
summary: In this paper we propose a finite-dimensional and deterministic approach to the study of invariant sets of certain nonautonomous differential inclusions naturally arising in the context of random and control dynamical systems, as well as in systems modeling the dynamical propagation of uncertainty.
